name: EasyStore
highlights: Editorial storefront in Next.js 16 and React 19 with a filterable shop: search, category, brand, price, rating and sale filters with live counts, all kept in the URL so results can be shared.
Three-step checkout with delivery or store pickup and MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash or AirtelTigo Money, with inline validation for Ghana phone numbers.
A ⌘K command palette over every product and collection, a slide-out bag with undo and save-for-later, and product galleries with hover zoom and swipe on mobile.
All 100 product pages and 11 collections are prerendered with per-page metadata, JSON-LD and a sitemap; dark mode follows the system and never flashes on load.
